## Bramble Foods opens new distribution hub and eyes expansion

31st July 2026

Kieran Howells

Bramble Foods has opened a new 67,000 sq ft national distribution centre in Market Harborough as the family-owned fine food supplier prepares to expand its workforce.

The LDC-backed business has moved into Lancaster House at Airfield Business Park, a purpose-built facility developed by Leicestershire County Council.

The site will become Bramble Foods’ main UK distribution hub, increasing its warehousing and stockholding capacity as it expands its product range and customer base.

Bramble Group, which includes Whitakers Chocolates, The Bay Tree and Lings, currently employs around 300 people and expects the new facility to support the creation of up to 50 skilled roles over the coming years.

Long-serving employee opens new site

# Uline offers up to $34 an hour, $5K bonuses at Plainfield warehouse

Uline's new distribution center in Plainfield. Contributed Photo

By Andrew Larson

September 9, 2026

Uline will hold a hiring event Saturday as it prepares to open its new 1.2 million-square-foot Plainfield distribution center in November.

The family-owned distributor of shipping, packaging and industrial supplies is recruiting warehouse associates for day and night shifts at the facility.

The hiring event will take place from 8 a.m. to noon Saturday, Sept. 12, at 113 Plainfield Pike.

The positions will pay between $26 and $34 an hour, depending on the shift and experience. New hires are also eligible for a $5,000 bonus, according to the company’s job posting.

Benefits include health insurance and a 401(k) with a 6% employer match starting on the first day of employment, along with paid time off and tuition assistance for continuing education. The facility will have an on-site fitness center.

The business has expanded into Lancaster House, a purpose-built 67,000 sq. ft distribution centre at Airfield Business Park, Market Harborough, built by Leicestershire County Council.

The state-of-the-art facility becomes Bramble Foods’ main national distribution hub, significantly increasing warehousing and distribution capacity while supporting the company’s expanding portfolio of premium food brands and growing customer base across the UK.

#### In Lustenau ist der Spatenstich für eine neue Werkstatthalle der Scheffknecht Transporte GmbH erfolgt. Die Inbetriebnahme ist für August oder September 2027 geplant.

„Vor rund fünf Jahren fiel der Entschluss für den Neubau. New Kenosha hub significantly expands G10 Fulfillment's Midwest warehouse capacity - KABA

#### New Kenosha hub significantly expands G10 Fulfillment’s Midwest warehouse capacity

 Posted in Kenosha County Economic Development 

A Delavan-based third-party logistics and fulfillment company has significantly expanded its Midwest warehouse capacity after moving into a new distribution facility in Kenosha.

G10 Fulfillment now occupies 315,000 square feet of a 600,000-square-foot building at 12345 38th St., just off Interstate 94. The move increases G10’s dock capacity to 65 doors from 30.

“The Midwest is probably the most important hub for us,” said co-founder and CEO Mark Becker, who was on hand Thursday for a ribbon-cutting at the facility. He pointed to the region’s freight infrastructure and its location along the trucking corridor between Chicago and Milwaukee.

Becker said the facility can handle nearly 7 acres of inventory under one roof. G10 shares the building with food manufacturer Eagle Foods.
